description: Prepare writing a file or creating a folder on a hosted website. Confirm required. Path is relative to the site root. Text by default; encoding base64 writes a binary file (images, fonts, PDF) up to 5 MB. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

content.description: File text, or base64 bytes with encoding base64. Required for write.

encoding.description: base64 for binary files (images, fonts, PDF), up to 5 MB.

path.description: Path relative to the site root.

name: oma_write_file
title: Write file
